title: Chartered buses from Newark
summary: Bands chartered buses that broke down often; he says love of music made up for the hardship.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: How did you travel, by buses?

No, no. We chartered a bus. There was a company in Newark that most all the bands chartered buses from. Newark Charter Company. I think the guy's name was Charlie something that had those buses. But it was the Newark Charter Company, and most all bands used those buses. They used to break down all the time, man. Hot sun -- and blow tires and break down all the time. Yeah, that was before bands started working up the Greyhound Buses and buses of that sort. But it was something else.

But, I did -- I don't know. If you love music, nothing deters you, you know. That's how we felt. We just loved to play. And there were obstacles but if you were a true musician at heart, you wouldn't let them stop you. You'd just go on playing, man. Because we had a lot of fun playing. So, it made up for a lot of adversities, you know.
